company.name: Arsann
company.shortDescription: ARSANN provides consulting services, a parking management app, and links gig-workers with part-time jobs.
company.description: ARSANN specializes in consulting services and offers a parking management app that allows operators to monitor cars entering and leaving their facilities. The company also links gig-workers with part-time job opportunities, enhancing workforce flexibility. Additionally, ARSANN collaborates with partners to build smart EV charging networks at parking facilities, contributing to sustainable transportation solutions.
